name: GHT token transferFrom missing allowance check
summary: GHT.transferFrom() moved tokens without checking the caller's allowance, so the attacker emptied the WETH/GHT Uniswap V2 pair's GHT reserve, called sync(), pushed the GHT back in and swapped the resulting imbalance out for WETH.

loss.notes: Imported from the seed inventory, which did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

ageReset.description: Last observed Upgraded event; completeness of causal state history remains unresolved.

limitations: Implementation activation and runtime identity are reproduced; verified source is unavailable for the implementation, and complete code-selecting and causal-state write paths have not been reviewed.
The earliest successful fault exercise and full campaign loss remain unresolved.

sources.note: onchain review: ERC1967Proxy 0x528e046ACfb52bD3f9c400e7A5c79A8a2c2863d0 created 2024-03-05T14:11:47Z by 0x2aa1eccb2dcb0c1ffd44abc6c92fcdd4d26fdc10, not the attack-tx sender 0x096f0f03e4be68d7e6dd39b22a3846b8ce9849a3; two EIP-1967 Upgraded events, the last at block 19376972 on 2024-03-06T15:17:11Z installing 0x17dfb09194ab77dcf318839cfdd01f587a73a77e — 13.3 hours before the exploit.

Bounded review reproduced source-1 receipt/callTracer and eth_getLogs for proxy Upgraded topic 0xbc7cd75a20ee27fd9adebab32041f755214dbc6bffa90cc0225b39da2e5c2d3b over [19369481,19380955]: two events, last source-5 at block 19376972 index 174 log 271 selecting 0x17dfb09194ab77dcf318839cfdd01f587a73a77e. Exploit trace delegates to that implementation; eth_getCode at 19380954 hashes to 0xc1b54e98a1eeaf3f13e6f4d4b7fd23b9a31879d7da28b1e1ab21352e8b77d058. Receipt WETH Transfer log 261 moves 15438613861386138610 wei from pair 0x706206eabd6a70ca4992eec1646b6d1599259cae to helper 0xcc5159b5538268f45afda7b5756fa8769ce3e21f; pair Sync log 262 leaves one wei WETH. GHT emits both NFT-like indexed Transfer logs and aggregate ERC-20-like transfers, so summing every Transfer topic is invalid. Etherscan V2 getsourcecode for the implementation returns an empty SourceCode; the proxy source alone cannot establish complete implementation write paths. Unresolved: earliest unauthorized hybrid-token transfer, whether intervening critical state enabled it, and complete campaign USD loss. Next: obtain bytecode-matching hybrid-token source or review its allowance/operator and upgrade/state-write control flow, replay all pair-related token movements from activation, then value the resulting victim WETH depletion. No semantic promotion. Transfer execution also calls proxy 0xaccbe3798c56de34c6df49b605873fd91b8caff8, which delegates selector 0x949d225d to 0xbd103a46d305d1fd84035f44194b69385fcb0713; its authorization/state role must be resolved before selecting all defect-bearing targets.

limitations: Classification and loss were imported from the seed inventory and await review.
